sources.title: recipes/models/vllm-sr/d3-flash.yaml at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: It is a backbone of the Qwen3.5 architecture (8.39B parameters, including the 0.46B vision encoder), trained from `Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B`, with an answer-code readout. vLLM detects the checkpoint's `decision_config.json` and serves it as a classification model (`D3ForSequenceClassification`) on its System One endpoint, `/v1/systemone`: one
